bundle.shortDescription: Manage a Sony DPT-RP1 and use it as a dashboard screen
bundle.longDescription: Inkboard manages the library and settings of a Sony DPT-RP1 Digital Paper reader over the local network and turns the reader into an e-ink dashboard screen.
